audit.framework_rationale: TensorCircuit FGSSimulator performs state initialization, non-unitary evolution, normalization, and correlation evaluation. JAX provides differentiation and iteration, Optax provides Adam, and NumPy formats outputs. No other quantum framework is imported by the submission.
audit.cheating_rationale: The source computes the optimization from the supplied configuration without hardcoded results, hidden data access, evaluator manipulation, or test/reward tampering. The Gaussian representation is an exact framework-supported simulation of this circuit.
audit.fidelity_rationale: The Hadamard-basis fermionic mapping implements the specified initial state, shared filter strengths, alternating open-boundary bonds, and Ising energy density. Generator coefficients correctly account for TensorCircuit's exp(-H/2) convention. Differentiable QR normalization represents normalization of the many-body state; additional normalization between filter groups leaves the normalized result and objective gradients equivalent. These conclusions follow from the [TensorCircuit implementation](https://tensorcircuit.readthedocs.io/en/latest/_modules/tensorcircuit/fgs.html). All configuration fields are consumed, exactly max_steps Adam updates run, and history records each pre-update energy. Returned parameter arrays have the required even/odd layout.
audit.implementation_error_rationale: No obvious implementation error was found. Filter signs and factors, Majorana observable extraction, energy normalization, optimizer timing, and output reshaping are consistent with the specification.
